schemaRepresentation: Manually transcribed input properties, required fields, defaults, and relevant behavior; not full JSON Schema or a server response

loader.reason: The required deferred-tool loader is absent from the callable tool interface. Do not bypass it.

tools.name: mcp_featurescript_create_feature_studio
tools.behavior: Creates an element in an already identified document workspace, not a public document.

tools.name: mcp_featurescript_create_geometry
tools.behavior: Creates a new branch from the service-configured document version, writes a Feature Studio, and adds a persistent feature. Does not return FeatureScript code errors.
preconditions: Authorized and positively verified sandbox scope
All parameters have defaults in the second defineFeature argument

tools.name: mcp_featurescript_edit_featurescript_notes
tools.behavior: Replaces one exact occurrence in service-managed notes.

tools.name: mcp_featurescript_get_api_usage
tools.behavior: Reports used, limit, remaining, cycle, and allocation metadata; may consume internal Onshape REST calls.

tools.name: mcp_featurescript_get_featurescript
tools.behavior: Reads source from an identified Feature Studio, not document visibility or persisted body measurements.

tools.name: mcp_featurescript_list_feature_studios
tools.behavior: Lists Feature Studios in an identified workspace.

tools.name: mcp_featurescript_logout
tools.behavior: Signs out only on explicit user request; not authorized or attempted here.

tools.name: mcp_featurescript_put_featurescript
tools.behavior: Overwrites an entire Feature Studio. Read existing source first; write finalized code once at the end. Not an exposed Part Studio parameter-edit operation.

tools.name: mcp_featurescript_read_featurescript_notes
tools.behavior: Required before writing any FeatureScript; reads service-managed notes.

tools.name: mcp_featurescript_search_featurescript_documentation
tools.behavior: Searches FeatureScript documentation, not a guaranteed document-visibility API.

tools.name: mcp_featurescript_set_api_allocation
tools.behavior: Views or changes allocation on explicit user request only; no change authorized here.

tools.name: mcp_featurescript_test_feature
tools.behavior: Writes a Feature Studio with a no-op helper, adds it to a Part Studio, and evaluates the feature through its namespace. Real compiler diagnostics, not a persistent benchmark result.
preconditions: All parameters defaulted in the second defineFeature argument
Existing version preserved; new code uses empirically detected live version

tools.name: mcp_featurescript_test_featurescript
tools.behavior: Evaluates a context/id lambda in the configured Part Studio. A trivial nonmutating lambda can return libraryVersion. Evaluation-local geometry is not persisted CAD.

tools.name: mcp_featurescript_whoami
tools.behavior: Account identity and allocation, not document visibility; not called and no personal identifiers retained.
